installAgentPrompt: Ku dhis HAX (https://haxtheweb.org) kombiyuutarkan. Rakib HAX CLI adigoo isticmaalaya `npm install @haxtheweb/create --global`, kadibna rakib xirfadaha wakiilka adigoo isticmaalaya `hax skills install --all`. Samee goob adigoo isticmaalaya `hax site my-hax-site --y --no-i`, ku bilow `cd my-hax-site && hax serve`, oo ii sheeg cinwaanka uu daabaco. Akhri AGENTS.md ee goobta iyo https://github.com/haxtheweb/praw ka hor intaadan waxba beddelin.
